description: Fetch one catalogue record from the National Archives of Georgia reference library by its biblionumber (the id archives_library_search returns), as parsed MARC. Returns the full MARC field/subfield structure plus a flattened summary of title, authors, imprint, ISBN, languages and physical description.

biblionumber.description: Koha biblionumber, e.g. "4035". Returned as `biblionumber` by archives_library_search.

name: archives_library_record
title: Archives Library Record
